sql: select 'order' k, market_ticker, side||' '||action||' '||limit_price||'x'||quantity v, status s, created_at::text t from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and status in ('resting','pending','unknown') union all select 'pos', p.market_ticker, p.quantity::text, coalesce(p.realized_pnl::text,''), p.captured_at::text from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from positions where market_ticker in (select distinct market_ticker from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1') order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) p where p.quantity <> 0 union all select 'now','','','',now()::text
